fileAssoc.setDefault: Set Open PDF Studio as Default PDF Viewer
fileAssoc.setDefaultHelp: This will open your system settings where you can select Open PDF Studio as the default application for opening PDF files.
fileAssoc.windowsInstructions:
Windows Settings opened.

To set Open PDF Studio as default:
1. Scroll down to "Choose default apps by file type"
2. Find .pdf
3. Click and select Open PDF Studio
fileAssoc.windowsFailed:
Could not open Windows Settings.

Please manually open Settings > Apps > Default Apps.
fileAssoc.macInstructions:
To set Open PDF Studio as default PDF viewer on macOS:

1. Right-click any PDF file in Finder
2. Select "Get Info"
3. Under "Open with", select Open PDF Studio
4. Click "Change All..."
fileAssoc.linuxInstructions:
To set Open PDF Studio as default PDF viewer on Linux:

Run in terminal:
xdg-mime default openpdfstudio.desktop application/pdf

explorerThumbnails.title: File Explorer
explorerThumbnails.show: Show PDF thumbnails in File Explorer
explorerThumbnails.help: File Explorer then shows the first page of each PDF instead of the PDF icon. This applies to your Windows account only and does not change your default PDF app.
explorerThumbnails.otherHandler: PDF thumbnails are currently provided by {{name}}.
explorerThumbnails.defaultApp: Your default PDF app shows its own thumbnails ({{name}}). Windows uses those as long as that app is your default PDF app.
explorerThumbnails.replaceConfirm:
{{name}} already provides PDF thumbnails in File Explorer.

Show the thumbnails of Open PDF Studio instead for your Windows account? Turning this option off restores the previous thumbnails.

virtualPrinter.title: Virtual Printer
virtualPrinter.description: "Open PDF Printer" is a Windows printer that turns a print from any program into a PDF and collects it in the printer window of this app.
virtualPrinter.saveDialogMode: Installed — still shows a Save dialog
virtualPrinter.installNote: Installation requires administrator privileges (UAC prompt). The printer uses the built-in "Microsoft Print to PDF" driver. Printing to it from any app catches the PDF in this app's merge window instead of saving immediately.
virtualPrinter.stateActiveDetail: Prints to {{printer}} arrive in the printer window without a Save dialog.
virtualPrinter.stateDialogDetail: Each print still asks where to save. Enable the PDF catch to collect prints in the printer window.
virtualPrinter.stateMissingDetail: Install the printer to make a PDF from any program.
virtualPrinter.stateUnknownDetail: The printer status could not be read.
virtualPrinter.how1: In any program choose Print and select {{printer}}.
virtualPrinter.how2: The print appears in the printer window of Open PDF Studio.
virtualPrinter.how3: Preview, reorder, merge and save the jobs as one PDF, or open them in Studio.
